sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small clumping cactus from Córdoba Province, Argentina. Its flattened stems are about 4 cm tall and up to 6 cm across.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The pale pink flowers may reach about 6 cm; the fruits are blue-green and ovoid. It grows in dry montane environments.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use or particular toxicity is established in the sources consulted.
